title: Envisioning Agentic Robotics: A New Era of Robotic Systems
abstract: arXiv:2611.18359v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The release of GPT-6 Astra marks the emergence of a new paradigm in robotics: agentic robotics. Within weeks, frontier models with agentic harnesses matched or exceeded task-specific policies on many embodied benchmarks. Instead of training a dedicated policy for each family of tasks, an agentic robotic system applies a foundation model to open-world embodied tasks. It operates in a closed loop: observing the environment, interpreting user intent, reasoning about the task, invoking skills and tools, verifying outcomes, and adapting its strategy. Despite these advances, the community has yet to converge on a shared definition, a reliable evaluation framework, or a research roadmap. We argue that Embodied System 2, realized by a foundation model together with an embodied harness, forms the decision-making core of agentic robotics. translated_title: 展望智能体机器人：机器人系统的新时代

tldr: 本文提出“智能体机器人”这一新范式，主张由基础模型与具身框架构成的“具身系统2”是智能体机器人的决策核心，并呼吁学界建立统一定义、评估框架与研究路线图。
en_tdlr: This paper envisions the new paradigm of agentic robotics, arguing that an Embodied System 2—realized by a foundation model with an embodied harness—forms its decision-making core, and calls for a shared definition, reliable evaluation framework, and research roadmap for the community.
